critique_summary: The platform is experiencing a total operational collapse. Seven consecutive critical failures in the core analysis engine (5/5 scheduler jobs failing) combined with persistent data pipeline staleness indicates the system is incapable of generating valid trade signals.
critique_flags: Repeated system degradation: platform_core failed 7 times between 21:47 and 23:17
Data pipeline latency consistently exceeding 300s threshold (max 404s)
Critical failure of 100% of scheduler jobs during analysis cycles
